author: meax
body: -Meax.  So today I was defending a friend who was being cyber bullied. I kinda got mad and lashed out on him. That was the first time I've ever done that. I got temp banned. I asked a friend if I could use an alt and he said sure. This said friend is Gimq. Now he's banned because they think I used his account to ban evade. Then I went on a got banned on the alt because I was ban evading. I had not known what ban evading was, and thought I could just play on another account. I got bored and went to on my main account and played. I know stupid right. All I am asking is to be unbanned I am fairly new here. I joined Minecraft to get my mind off of losing contact with my mother. I know you probably care, but MC is all I got. I've been abused, my mother has lost her leg due to surgery and this is all just hard. My life is pretty horrible and I only have 5 close friends. I thought about killing myself time to time but held it within not to do that. I know in delving in to far, but I just want to let you know that Minecraft is the only place where I can be me. I have learned my lesson. This community is great. I really don't want to leave it. I am so very sorry for eating your time.

title: I am permanently banned

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

You may have just touched a nerve, however the fact that you evaded a ban not even 5 days long is your fault and I feel sympathy for you, but I doubt you've learnt your lesson in the space of 2 hours, I suggest you submit another appeal in later weeks and maybe by then you will have learnt your lesson.
-Denied 

Regards,
Blizzem_
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
